versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated documentation to note CLI v1.2+ is required for localize/variations/edit features.
- Added a new section detailing how to refine existing visuals using the `canvora localize` command instead of regenerating from scratch.
- Clarified that edits, localization, and variations cost 10 credits per visual and may require certain plan features.
- No impact to main generation commands or core functionality.

Initial release of Canvora CLI integration.

- Generate on-brand visuals (social, marketing, presentations) from text, URLs, or PDFs in 100+ formats and 150+ languages.
- Supports per-client brand kits for consistent colors, fonts, logos, and tone.
- Batch multiple formats in one command with flexible slide counts for carousels.
- Outputs provided as JSON with file URLs; credits and errors transparently handled.
- All generated visuals are also available for review and editing in the Canvora dashboard.
